title: Lab - Static Pods
description: Find, create and delete static Pods on a node.
scenario: Find, create and delete static Pods on a node. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Count them
tasks.instructions: How many static Pods are running in the cluster? How can you tell from the name?
tasks.solution: kubectl get pods -A | grep -- -controlplane  # suffix is the node name

tasks.title: Task 2 - Find the directory
tasks.instructions: On the control plane node, where does the kubelet read static Pod manifests from?

tasks.title: Task 3 - Create one
tasks.instructions: Create a static Pod static-busybox that runs `sleep 1000` with image busybox.
